problem: Local discovery dedup tests do not prove the repository-host deterministic proposal fingerprint claim path yields exactly one winner under real concurrent distinct-worker contention.
acceptance: Two distinct workers racing the same canonical discovery identity at the exact proposal-claim path produce exactly one create winner.
The losing worker observes the existing fingerprint claim and does not publish a duplicate proposal.
A five-worker contention case still produces one winner and bounded loser re-entry evidence.
The canary remains candidate-scoped and grants no Current, Human Accepted, Served, or execution authority.
title: Canarizar el pin de discovery en el host real
mission: Run bounded repository-host contention canaries against the deterministic proposal fingerprint claim path, prove exactly-one-winner behavior for 2-worker and 5-worker races, record loser behavior without duplicate proposal publication, and leave candidate evidence without promoting product authority.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents surplus /wc workers from publishing duplicate discovery work when they race on the same semantic gap.

unblock_value.reason: Closes the explicit evidence gap left by the local-only dedup implementation return before the mechanism can be trusted under repository contention.

reuse_value.reason: A proven host-side primitive is reusable by every future surplus discovery worker without task-specific coordination.

candidate_write_scope: bounded canary-only proposal-claim fixtures/receipts under coordination; no Current/Human Accepted/Served mutation
falsification: Fail the canary if more than one contender can create the same deterministic fingerprint claim, if a loser publishes a duplicate proposal, if contention cannot be reconstructed from durable receipts, or if any canary artifact claims product authority.
